headline: Handmade to fit
your home.
copy.sub: Carpentry, plastering and kitchen fitting across Ipswich, Suffolk, Norfolk and Essex. Over 30 years' experience, a clear quote up front and a tidy job at the end of every day.
copy.lede: Marty, Marcel and the team have over 30 years of carpentry, plastering and building experience. Every job is made to fit the room it's in, from a single shelf to a whole kitchen, and no job is too big or too small.

services.title: Bespoke carpentry
services.blurb: Alcove bookcases, fitted cupboards, under-stair storage and one-off pieces, made to measure.
services.intro: Every piece is made for the space it's going in, in softwood or hardwood, painted or left natural.

services.title: Media walls
services.blurb: TV walls with a built-in fire, lit shelving and storage, designed around your room.
services.intro: A media wall hides the cables, frames the TV and gives the room a focal point.

services.title: Plastering
services.blurb: Skimming, float and set, drylining, plasterboarding, coving and rendering.
services.intro: From one ceiling to a full re-plaster, finished smooth and ready for decorating.

services.title: Kitchen installations
services.blurb: Full kitchens fitted: units, worktops, appliances, flooring and the plastering around them.
services.intro: We fit the whole room, so there's one team from the strip-out to the last cupboard handle.

services.title: Doors and staircases
services.blurb: Internal doors hung, frames trued up in older houses, stairs repaired and new balustrades.
services.intro: Old houses rarely have square frames. We plane, pack and adjust until every door closes properly.

services.title: Building work
services.blurb: Knock-throughs, stud walls, alterations and general building for homes and businesses.
services.intro: General building for domestic and commercial customers, carried out by the same team that finishes the job.

steps.title: Open it up
steps.text: Walls you don't need come out, the opening is made good and the room is ready to build.

steps.title: Board and line
steps.text: Stud walls framed and boarded, old walls drylined so they're straight and flat.

steps.title: Skim
steps.text: A smooth new skim on the walls and ceilings, left to dry properly before anything goes on.

steps.title: Fit
steps.text: Units, worktops and appliances fitted, every door and drawer lined up.

steps.title: Finished
steps.text: Lights in, stools out, dust gone. A room you'll want to spend all day in.

gallery: Alcove shelves and cupboard, ready to paint
reviews: Marty and Marcel built a custom-made set of cupboards for us in our spare bedroom. We'd trawled the Internet for hours looking for something we liked but didn't have any luck, so that's when we turned to Marty to create it for us and to our exact spec.

I asked Marty to replace my doors and staircase. He did a fantastic job and I'm delighted with the results. The work was completed to a really good standard and Marty was punctual and fastidious about cleaning up at the end of each day. Highly recommended.

Great service, done within the time frame given. We had walls and ceiling skimmed and new coving put up as well as new skirting, architrave, new door, new floor and a false wall put in for integrated fire. We are really pleased with the work.

They repaired my stairs, very quick and efficient and very tidy. Then they built some bespoke bookcases in our alcoves. Very good craftsmen, friendly and very communicative. Would definitely recommend.
Marty has just installed six internal doors and put in shelving and done some other carpentry work for us. I'd recommend his company without any hesitation.
faqs: Yes. Tell us about the job, send a few photos if you can, and we'll come back with a clear, free quote.
We're based in Ipswich and work across Suffolk, Norfolk and Essex.
Can you do the carpentry and the plastering?
Yes, that's what we do. One team strips out, boards, plasters and fits, so you're not juggling trades.
Do you make furniture to measure?
Yes. Bookcases, cupboards, wardrobes and media walls are made to fit the exact space, including awkward alcoves.
Do you work for businesses as well?
Yes, we take on domestic and commercial work.
Every day. Customers mention it in their reviews.
